notes.title: Dev Update #6: who is she
notes.content:
Hello supporters of the great burger agenda!


Remember when you were a kid, and video games used to come with a lil booklet telling you all about the world and the characters? WE WANNA BRING THAT BACK. 



…in digital form, at least. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/136fa7242f2f0edee45ef1ff2cdb4d8e3e4217d9.png"]

She is all of us. 


P is for Player Character, and also Patty
A fiend for entering no-effort competitions, Patty may have bitten off more than she can chew when she won this failing burger truck. 



She’s not the type to put much thought into the long term, but hey, now that she’s here, she could totally design some burgers and run a business. After all, it’s one failing business, how hard could it be?


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/dd832a210cb6820cad0e0feadd7883a8be78c1dd.png"]

This is the face of someone who’s never worked in hospitality before.

Designing Patty
Patty’s character is inspired by a few of our favourite cartoons. Here’s a recipe for designing Patty:

1 cup of Bee’s determination to march to her own beat, even to her own detriment. (Bee & Puppycat)

½ cup of Steven’s willingness to see the best in everybody and everything. (Steven Universe)

¼ cup of Mordecai’s insecurities and immaturity. (The Regular Show)

¾ cup of Linda’s unflinching enthusiasm. (Bob’s Burgers)

3 heaped tablespoons of Dipper’s creative problem solving… and habit of making things worse for himself. (Gravity Falls)

1 teaspoon of Spongebob’s reckless optimism. (Spongebob Squarepants)

Throw them all in a grinder until the meat is nice and minced, then shape it into a Patty. Enjoy that mental image! :)




Patty is a character of indeterminate age, and only slightly more determinate gender. She’s happy to use whatever pronouns people call her. She has more important things to think about, like if she could deep-fry a taco (yes) and if it’s safe to do so in the food truck while Fry isn’t around (no).



While Patty doesn’t exactly love to work, she’d rather drive this truck into the ocean and take Fry and a week’s supply of burger ingredients with her than be perceived as lazy. Below her own insecurities though, what she really wants is to put her feet up, enjoy some munchies and imagine she is free from the pressing weight of capitalism. 



Visually, we knew we wanted Patty and Fry to feel like their namesakes, so a lot of our discussion revolved around “this, but people”:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/72a84d89c626ddc72b3747941e20c420a81cc85b.png"]

Courtesy of BanjoZebra on Wikimedia Commons.



Our artist Jackal took the idea and ran with it through her textured hair and layered burger coloured clothing! Fun fact: we were exploring how we wanted to do the player character’s gender at the same time as exploring her design, so these concept sketches are varying degrees of masc to femme.  



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/01755fcd709efad52653c5ef2b71c7b9e7953953.jpg"]

We landed in butch-femme territory in the end, and it just feels right somehow. 😌💅



When we moved into colour design, we made an unexpected discovery…



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/d371fe8c81a5023f19ca2fee05b40cfa2e1f189a.png"]

Entirely unintentional, but it tickled us. 😂


A relatably weird little world
We hope you’ve enjoyed this lil peek behind the curtain. We’d love to do another one of these sometime for Fry, or even the Truck (vehicle design is fun!), so watch this space. 👀


Until next time,

Jess, Alex, Jackal & Anthony

notes.title: Dev Update #5: New ingredients revealed!
notes.content:
Hello flavor-mongers! 



If you had the pleasure of tuning in to Frosty Games Fest this morning, you may have noticed a cheeky few ingredients we’ve never shown before. 👀 (And if you missed it, you can catch the showcase here!) 


Cooking beyond the classics
Burger Bois would hardly be a game of flavor experimentation if all you had to play with were bacon cheeseburger ingredients. We love bacon and cheese - but burgers can be so much more! Introducing:


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/21e5c34095b30b2415f92b49fc9821edc043c2bd.png"]Live your sweet and spicy breakfast burger dreams with Waffle Buns, Kimchi, and Sriracha Sauce.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/773d9c387113e583404308b6f2aaf1ce017bc614.png"]Make an “oops, all purple” burger with Radicchio and Sliced Radish! (Dibs-not on taste-testing this one…)


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/8861b0b019fd5210e181f56d494cb5d60c66e56c.png"]Break your customers’ banks with a Dark Chocolate and Shaved Truffles bougie burger.



With heaps more ingredients to come, all this burger potential is just the start. 😌


How we choose ingredients
The only hard rule we have is it has to be a real ingredient (sorry, no Unicorn Steak Sandwiches). We have a couple of thought starters to help us choose:

What flavor and property profiles are missing from the game?

What ingredient categories do we need more of?

What would be weird and wonderful?

What would people be excited to see on socials?

What might suit the theme of a particular parking spot?

This time around, we wanted to add bitter, spicy, and unusual ingredients! (We can already hear PAX AUS players rejoicing at having more spicy options. 🌶️)



We also aaaaalmost ended up with Sauerkraut too, but this time around it lost to our need for protein with a Fish Fillet Patty. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/9f74544e4a882bfaceddc882346a531001c198a6.png"]Sorry Finn.


What’ve you got a hankering for?
Think back to the most exciting burger you’ve ever had. What made it different? How did it taste? And can you tell us what it was so we can put in our game? 👁️🫦👁️


What other ingredients should we add? Tell us on your platform of choice: Bluesky | Twitter / X | Instagram | TikTok



We wanna make your ingredient ideas happen! 🙏


Deliciously yours,

Jess, Alex, Jackal & Anthony

notes.title: Dev Update #3: The Secret Recipe Behind Burger Bois
notes.content:
Hi friends!

This month, we’re diving into the beginnings of Burger Bois—the inspiration and the backstory that brought this game to life. So, grab a snack (preferably a burger) and let’s get into it!

💌 A Love Letter to Food & Hospitality
Burger Bois is our love letter to food, creativity, and the joy of serving up something delicious. It’s a mash-up of everything we adore: the food service vibes of Good Pizza, Great Pizza, the creative challenge of Sticky Business, and the quirky, comedic characters of Ace Attorney. But where did the idea for this burger building adventure come from? Let’s rewind to 2019.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/4049a615163a4c2dbb40603434de9c17b4ad0768.png

💡 The Birth of Burger Bois
The idea for Burger Bois was first cooked up by Alex, our resident foodie, while reflecting on his sister Jess’… let’s say, complicated relationship with cooking. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/ad377aea8988cdc3e15f7e94067be008999890b2.jpg
Pictured: Jess, trying to cook.

Jess’ disdain for the kitchen combined with their shared love for Burger Wellington—an annual burger festival in New Zealand—and cartoons like Spongebob Squarepants and Bob’s Burgers sparked a thought:

“What if we could make a game that turns cooking-nonbelievers into cooking-converts through the power of humor, creativity, and a whole lot of flavor?”

For Alex, part of the joy of cooking is experimenting—and he’s not alone! We’re huge fans of Roll For Sandwich, Binging with Babish, and Sorted Food. We wanted to capture that same sense of joy and discovery in Burger Bois—trying new things, sometimes failing, and always having fun.

Fast forward to late 2021, and pre-production began during COVID-19 lockdown as a sibling side hustle for Jess and Alex. But things heated up in March 2024 when we secured the NZ CODE KickStart grant, which helped us bring the core Burger Design game loop to life. Now, we’re building out the full game loop, adding fresh content, and gearing up to put out a demo.

🤔 What Makes Burger Bois Special?
You may have heard that Burger Bois is a food truck simulator about flavor, not labor. As Patty, your job is to design burgers that match your customers’ vague, and sometimes downright alarming requests, manage your stock, and build up your truck’s reputation in a world that’s under the deeply incorrect impression that burgers are “mid.”

Most cooking games focus on the “choppy-choppy” (physically simulating cooking) or combining ingredients like “X + Y = preset outcome Z.” But we wanted to do something different. What if we removed those elements and focused purely on the flavors and physical properties of the burgers you design? That’s the core of Burger Bois—a game that celebrates taste, experimentation, and, of course, burgers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/aa31a1a534b4656397836d8b79f79cab5a8a3f0f.png

👀 What’s Next?
We’re still hard at work on the game, adding new features, locations, ingredients, and customers (both friend and foe). 

In the meantime, if you haven’t already, wishlist Burger Bois on Steam and help us spread the word. Every wishlist brings us one step closer to sharing this flavor-packed adventure with the world.

Here’s to another month of creativity, burgers, and good vibes! 🍔🎮
Jess, Alex, Jackal, Stevi & Anthony

notes.title: Dev Update #2: Cooking up the metagame
notes.content:
Hello burger lovers! Now that our burger design & customer request systems are in a good place, we’ve been focusing on what managing your truck might look like - aka, the metagame.

😋 Making the game feel more “full”
Keeping the balance between ‘giving the player enough levers to pull’ whilst keeping within our casual management sim genre has been an interesting design challenge.

Our catchphrase with Burger Bois has always been ‘flavor not labor’, so we wanted to make sure whatever we design here doesn’t feel like work to play. This is Patty’s dayjob, but it shouldn’t feel like the player’s dayjob!

Part of this process has involved researching reference games like Good Pizza Great Pizza, Sticky Business, Potionomics, and Potion Craft, to get a feel for what might work well with a Burger Bois flavor. Our notes from those sessions helped us brainstorm the wider game loop!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/d79e2299e38ff5687229d09f34455ab089efcff5.png
Top secret game loop design work, ooooooo

😅 Just because you can, doesn’t mean you should
Once we’d prototyped these new features & tested them with our core audience, we asked ourselves: are these the right fit for our casual management sim game?

When we started the project we established three core pillars:

 Real-world transferable ingredient knowledge
 Reward experimentation
 Weird and delightful
Comparing each part of the new metagame to those pillars helped us to identify what to keep, and what to cut. 🔪🔪🔪

One feature we were considering cutting fell squarely into the ‘weird and delightful’ bucket, so we decided to keep that on and re-tool it to better fit the game. Another feature accidentally punished players for experimenting, so that hit the chopping block! (Maybe we’ll bring it back for an optional game mode though, who knows.)

👀 So what’s in the metagame, then? 
We’re keeping the details hush hush for now, but the ideas we’ve been exploring include:

 Time management without timers
 Finding the balance between practicality and the joy of discovery with stocking new ingredients
 Ways to influence your business beyond just serving customers
 Social media’s role in indie hospitality success
 The intersection between your truck, and the places you park it
 Goofing off at work can be good for you, actually
When we’ve got more to share on that front, you’ll be the first to know!

🙏 Thanks for reading!
We hope you’ve enjoyed this lil exploration of our process, and thank you for your continued support of Burger Bois. 🥰

Until next time,
Jess, Alex, Jackal, Stevi & Anthony

notes.title: Dev Update #1: 2024 - A Tasty Year in Review
notes.content:
Hi friends! 2024 was a sizzling year for Mischief Makers Studio, and we’re excited to share the highlights with you. Here’s a quick look at what we cooked up in the past year:

Securing the Secret Sauce: NZ CODE KickStart Funding
In March 2024, we were thrilled to secure NZ CODE KickStart funding. This support was the special sauce that helped us bring Burger Bois to life. 

The funding allowed us to prototype the core loop of the game and dive into visual development for our characters, ingredients, and the food truck with our talented artist, Jackal. Plus, our sound engineer and composer, Anthony, crafted some juicy SFX and an original track that truly slaps! We also built our first demo for private playtesting, and set our sights on PAX AUS.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/f05d728a3c686ff31a34d56e9193f6950c660405.png
 
Burger Bois at PAX AUS
One of our favorite moments of the year was serving up Burger Bois at PAX AUS in Melbourne. It was an incredible experience to meet fellow gamers and developers, and to finally share a little taste of our game with the world. 

During the three-day October event, more than 180 players got their hands on the game, collectively serving up a whopping 775 burgers! Among all those players, only 21 managed to unlock a secret collectible #foodpic, so consider this a challenge for our next playtest. 👀 Exhibiting was the highlight of our year, and we loved every minute of it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203099/151517d04afc4173bbdd5570b4faa984c97a9430.png
 
Wishlist Whopper: Over 1,000 Strong
Thanks to your appetite for "flavor not labor," we ended the year with over 1,000 wishlists. It’s been amazing to see so many people take an interest in our game. Each wishlist helps us spread the word and the hype. Here’s to stacking up even more in the coming year!
 
Looking Ahead to 2025
For 2025, we’re keeping the grill on full heat. We're prototyping and building out the meta loop of the game, and there’s a whole menu of new assets on the way. Expect fresh locations, exciting ingredients, and new customers both friend and foe. We’re also gearing up for more playtests so keep your eyes peeled for playtester callouts in the coming months. 👀

We’re on a mission to connect with more burger lovers, and on that note, we’re stoked to welcome Stevi to our team as Junior Community Manager and Games Writer. Stevi loves to eat, yap, and write, and they’re ready to dig in! 😌

Hungry for the latest scoop? Join our mailing list and stay in the loop with all the juicy updates from Burger Bois!

Here’s to another year of flavor-packed fun! 🍔🎮 
Jess, Alex, Jackal, Stevi & Anthony

notes.title: Taste-test Burger Bois at PAX Australia 2024!
notes.content:
Order up!

Mischief Makers Studio from Aotearoa New Zealand are proud to be serving up a sizzling hot demo for their debut title, Burger Bois, at PAX Australia in 2024.

With the support of NZ CODE, Burger Bois will be playable for all attendees at PAX Australia. Find NZ CODE (booth #1140) in the Expo Hall and keep an eye out for ‘Burger Bois’ to play the free demo.

[previewyoutube=9yzcTZiBB18;full][/previewyoutube]
You can support the dev team right now by wishlisting Burger Bois here on Steam! Go on, while it’s hot. 

For more on Mischief Makers Studio and Burger Bois, visit the press kit and follow the team on Twitter, TikTok, and Instagram. 

About Burger Bois
Burger Bois is a food truck simulator game about flavor, not labor. Operate the world’s first designer burger truck, turning your customers’ most vague requests into culinary masterpieces (or disasterpieces). There’s no recipe and no one right answer: just follow your tongue to flavor heaven.

 Food prep is out. Flavor design is in. Consider the real-world properties and flavors of ingredients to design uniquely satisfying burgers.
 Who needs a menu anyway? Interpret increasingly vague requests to try and impress your customers.
 Let’s get experimental. Play with your food to collect over 20 elusive food showcase illustrations.
 We’re all weird here. Get to know a cast of relatably weird friends, enemies, and customers (who are sometimes also enemies).
 Lightheartedly cutthroat competition. Manage your truck and boost your reputation to score the hottest parking spots in town!
 Flavor made real. Share your creations with friends—and even export the recipes so you can taste-test for yourself.


About Mischief Makers Studio
Newly founded by sister-brother duo Jess and Alex Woodward, Mischief Makers Studio received a KickStart Grant from the New Zealand Centre of Digital Excellence (NZ CODE) this year to produce a vertical slice of Burger Bois.

As a developer team, Mischief Makers Studio aims to create nonviolent games that inspire creativity, conversation and laughter.
